name: Workplace: creative studio
about: A design, architecture, media or advertising studio: one open studio with room to pin up and review, a materials library, a workshop for models, edit and sound rooms that want no window, a gallery at the front. In three parts: the Workplace: creative studio typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.1.0: its walls, fences, railings, parapets, beams, doors and windows in the versions that say how they sit and meet (R156: justify, corner, priority, align), all as before until one is set.
